root_phase_alphabet.logical_boundary: a one-step Z5 deck generator cannot have phase -pi/2; an internal-only account would therefore require a compound or non-generator transfer step

score.coordinates: complex A rows, four hand-charge channels, d=1..5
score.covariance: delete-one covariance from the original 160 batches, refitting the rank-two recurrence in every deletion

decision_rule: rank candidates by the frozen all-distance covariance score
if only q=1 has p>=0.01, call the second state direction invariant and reject a spatial C4 direction character for this row
if exactly one q=+i or q=-i candidate has p>=0.01, retain the corresponding spatial C4 direction character
if multiple candidates pass, report unresolved direction character; do not pick by root-phase proximity
if none passes, the one-character relation is insufficient
claim_boundary: The rank-two dimension and roots are not reselected.
The exact phase alphabet is frozen before looking at reconstructed X/Y means.
Root phase and displacement-direction character are separate tests.
A direction-invariant outcome does not identify the state as a one-step Z5 deck generator.
No new random stream is generated.
